Name: Gaius of Derbe
Summary: Gaius of Derbe was one of the companions who travelled with Paul from Greece toward Jerusalem, accompanying him through Macedonia and on to Troas. He is distinguished by his home city from Gaius of Macedonia.
KeyStory: Gaius of Derbe travelled with Paul's company toward Jerusalem, one of the bearers of the churches' gift.
LifeLesson: The collection for Jerusalem travelled on faithful feet. Gaius of Derbe walked it toward the holy city.
